- Always read `AGENTS.md` first.
- Current durable product docs:
  - `docs/product-ux-pattern.md`
  - `docs/product-copy.md`
  - `docs/interaction-patterns.md`
  - `docs/ui-reference.md`
  - `docs/frontend-current-state.md`
  - `docs/ux-known-gaps.md`
- Historical planning only (not current frontend architecture):

- Treat `AGENTS.md` and the current working tree as the frontend engineering source of truth.
